verses.1: And the word of Jehovah came to me, saying:
verses.2: And you, son of Adam, have built a nest on the rock.
verses.3: And you said to the gate that stands on the entrance to the sea, leading people to many islands: “Thus says the Lord Jehovah: You have spoken correctly. I am the One who judges.”
verses.4: In the midst of seas, your borders are beautiful; your entire appearance is lovely.
verses.5: In brass, we have made for you all your utensils. From copper, they were made; they were used to make decorations on your heads.
verses.6: The people of Bashan made your wood into tools; they carved it into decorations for the women of Kithairia.
verses.7: Six hundred men from Egypt were your servants, who served as your workers and laborers. They were from the people of Elisha; they were your protectors.
verses.8: The rulers of Sidon and Arwad were your wise counselors. They were your guides in all matters.
verses.9: The elders of Gibl and their wise men were those who possessed knowledge about all the creatures in the sea. Their wisdom was like a light that illuminated your entire world.
verses.10: Pars, Lud, and Poot were among your soldiers. They defended you and protected you from harm. They gave you guidance in all your battles.
verses.11: The sons of Arud and your army, who rule over your lands around here. They stand on your hills. Their reign over your lands is complete. They are all beautiful.
verses.12: Your treasures are more than all the gold and silver in the world. They’re stored in vessels made of bronze, and they’re also covered with gold. These treasures have been given to you by your enemies.
verses.13: Yavan Tuvall and Meshachh – these are the ones who have lived in your land. All those who were like scorpions were given over to you.
verses.14: From the house of Togarmah, horses, sheep, and other animals were given to you.
verses.15: Children of Dedan, you are like many lions. Your hands are full of weapons and armor. They have returned to you what was taken from you.
verses.16: You have become too busy with your own actions and creations. You’ve spent all your time weaving, crafting, and creating things. But in the end, all these efforts were wasted in vain.
verses.17: Judea and the land of Israel: these are your pasturelands. There are meadows, fields, shrubs, vines, and other plants that were given to you by God.
verses.18: Your skin becomes rough and rough from all your actions. It’s covered with wine, milk, and leather.
verses.19: And Dan and Yavon Meuzal, in your abandonment, were given iron objects. They were made from iron, and they were placed in your ruins.
verses.20: Dadan, you are wearing clothes of shame, to ride in them.
verses.21: And all the kings of Kedar, they are your enemies; they trade in cattle, sheep, and goats. In them, you find your enemies.
verses.22: Oh, you who are full of anger and violence! Your anger is everywhere, in every tree and every precious stone. Gold was given to you, but you have abandoned me.
verses.23: Haran, Kanaan, and Eden – these are the lands of the people of Ashur. They have learned your ways.
verses.24: All your goods are stored in various places: in warehouses, in chests, and in bags that are packed tightly.
verses.25: My heart is filled with your songs; it becomes full and beautiful in my heart.
verses.26: In many waters, the dolphins brought you here. The spirit of the past blessed you with its presence in the hearts of the waters.
verses.27: Go away from me, and leave me alone! Get rid of your saltiness and your bitterness. Let those who are enemies of you go away from you. All those who are in your army will fall with their hearts broken in the day of your destruction.
verses.28: To the cry of your sorrows, they will be silenced from their places.
verses.29: And all those who were in their ships came down from them: all the sailors and soldiers of the sea. They stood on the land.
verses.30: And they shall shout against you with their voices; they shall cry out in pain, and hair will rise on their heads like a stormy wind.
verses.31: And they wept over me, and they held their heads in their hands. They mourned for me with all their hearts.
verses.32: And they brought their children to me as offerings. They built an altar for me, just as a priest does in the temple.
verses.33: As you leave these seas, many nations will be defeated by your power. The kings of the earth will be numerous in your reign.
verses.34: At that time, when you are destroyed by the waves in the depths of the sea, and all your people fall into destruction.
verses.35: All the kings of the islands sat upon you, and their rulers opened their mouths in anger.
verses.36: You were hated by those nations; they spoke evil of you. But you will never be forgotten forever.
